feat(s3): add presigned POST upload support (#120)
Implement S3 presigned POST (browser-based) uploads via multipart/form-data
POST to /{bucket}. This is the standard AWS mechanism for browser-based
file uploads using pre-signed policies.

Changes:
- S3Controller: detect multipart/form-data POST on /{bucket} and route to
  handlePresignedPost instead of returning InvalidArgument
- Parse multipart body to extract form fields (key, policy, Content-Type,
  x-amz-credential, x-amz-signature, etc.) and file data
- Validate content-length-range from the Base64-encoded policy JSON
- Store object via S3Service.putObject with Content-Type from form field
- Return 204 with ETag and Location headers (AWS-compatible response)

Tests:
- 11 new integration tests covering: basic upload, binary data, content-length
  validation (reject + accept), missing key/file fields, no-policy upload,
  Content-Type precedence (form field over file part), non-existent bucket

fix(python-aiohttp, python-blueplanet, python-flask): read header/cookie params from the request; stop overwriting non-body params from the body (#25362)
* fix(python-aiohttp, python-blueplanet, python-flask): read header params from request and avoid overwriting non-body model params

Connexion only binds path, query, body, files, and context arguments to
controller handlers and never passes header parameters, causing required
header parameters in generated controller signatures to fail with
TypeError at runtime. In addition, python-blueplanet and python-flask
unconditionally deserialized non-container model parameters from
request.get_json(), overwriting non-body model parameters such as $ref
query parameters with the request body.

Exclude header parameters from controller signatures via
x-non-header-params and read them from request headers inside the

fix(python-aiohttp, python-blueplanet, python-flask): map params iterate .items(); free-form params skip from_dict (#25361)
* fix(python-aiohttp, Connexion servers): iterate .items() for map params and skip from_dict on free-form params

In python-aiohttp controller.mustache, map parameter comprehensions iterated
over dict keys instead of .items(), raising ValueError at runtime when
unpacking (k, v). Add .items() to match python-blueplanet and python-flask.

In python-aiohttp, python-blueplanet, and python-flask controller.mustache,
guard non-container model deserialization with {{^isFreeFormObject}} and
{{^isAnyType}} so free-form object (schema: {type: object}) and untyped
(schema: {}) parameters are not deserialized via .from_dict().

fix(python-aiohttp): update generated test fixture for pytest-aiohttp 1.x (#25372)
pytest-aiohttp 1.x switched to pytest-asyncio and removed the deprecated
`loop` fixture in 1.1.0, causing `fixture 'loop' not found` errors in
generated tests.

Update `conftest.mustache` to define `client` as an async fixture awaiting
`aiohttp_client(app.app)`, configure `asyncio_mode = auto` in `tox.mustache`,
and require `pytest-aiohttp>=1.0.0` and `pytest-asyncio>=0.17.2` in
`test-requirements.mustache`.
